title: Why Your Car's Windshield Has a Black Frit Band
hook: Stop ignoring that black dotted border.

script.narration: Stop ignoring that black dotted border.
script.visual_search: close up of car windshield black ceramic dots

script.narration: That dark ceramic paint is called a frit. It hides the glue holding your glass in place. But those tiny fading dots serve a bigger purpose. They block harsh sunlight from melting the urethane adhesive and distribute heat evenly so your glass does not crack from temperature shock.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you knew about the frit? Comment yes or no, because if you didn't...
script.visual_search: driver looking through windshield sunny day

description: Ever wonder what the black dots and ceramic borders on your car windshield actually do? Learn the hidden engineering behind the automotive frit band and how it protects your windshield glass.
why_it_will_work: Leverages curiosity about everyday automotive details that most drivers see constantly but never understand.
